headlines.text: On this day in 2023, Jon Moxley vs. Big Bill went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.74. This stood as the 20th match in AEW International Title history ? a notable milestone for the title. Moxley overcame interference from Ricky Starks to lock Big Bill in a standing triangle choke in his hometown of Cincinnati, retaining the International Title.
Looking back to 2023, when Samoa Joe vs. Roderick Strong met in a Tournament Final, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.21 ? a good, competitive contest.
On this day in 2023, it marked the first-ever meeting between Allin & Wayne and 2.O on Dynamite, rated 5.26.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Toni Storm vs. Britt Baker vs. Hikaru Shida vs. Nyla Rose met in a Qualifying Match on Dynamite, rated 5.07.
